title: 第8章 把陆穿挖空了
content_zh:
“你是？”

    黄雷看着谷川，一时间还真的认不出来这是谁。

    他们见过吗？

    “我是艺菲的朋友啊。”谷川说道。

    “哦哦哦。”黄雷点头。

    刘艺菲他知道，02级表演系的一个小姑娘，挺漂亮的，看着也挺有灵气。

    关键是，他和刘艺菲也不认识啊，你一个刘艺菲的朋友，那就更不认识了。

    但伸手不打笑脸人，两人热切的寒暄起来。

    寒暄的过程中，黄雷也知道了，谷川是南加州导演系的，还是这部电影的制片人，于是表现得比刚才热情了几分。

    谷川说道：“黄老师，你也是知道的，我是南加州大学导演系的。”

    黄雷点头。

    他知道，咱俩聊天才多一会啊，你都说好几遍了。

    他看着谷川，心中猜测，这人应该是一个挺自傲的，不然也不会一直显摆自己的学历出身。

    谷川继续说道：“所以我对国内的电影行业也不熟悉，所以想请黄老师给我介绍一些电影圈的人，最好是北电的。”

    黄雷脸上挂着笑。

    你这人多少有点冒昧了啊。

    咱才第一次见面，你就让我帮忙，这合适吗？

    “行，我帮你问问。”

    黄雷能怎么办，当然是敷衍着来，总不能当面拒绝了人家。

    谷川也不在意他的敷衍之词，看上去对他挺感激的。

    黄雷来探班只是一个小插曲，谷川的工作重心，还是放在《见鬼》剧组里面的。

    电影拍摄的相当顺利，10月开始拍摄，到了十二月，就已经进入拍摄尾期了。

    晚上，谷川和曹郁聚在一个小房间里面。

    相处了一个多月，谷川和曹郁的关系还不错，而且几乎约定好拍摄下一部电影了。

    曹郁问道：“你电影投资多少？”

    “还没定。”

    曹郁一顿，突然感觉谷川有点不靠谱，他继续问道：“那演员你准备找谁？”

    “还不知道呢，但肯定要找一个知名度高的女演员。”谷川说道。

    曹郁开始牙疼。

    演员也没确定，更加不靠谱了。

    “那剧本是什么，可以给我看看吗？”

    谷川看了曹郁一眼，低声说道：“剧本还没写呢。”

    “告辞！”
content_en:
"You are?"

    Huang Lei looked at Tanichuan, and for a moment he really couldn't recognize who it was.

    Have they seen it?

    "I'm Yifei's friend." Tanichuan said.

    "Oh oh oh." Huang Lei nodded.

    He knows Liu Yifei, a little girl from the 02-level acting department, who is very beautiful and looks very smart.

    The point is, he doesn't know Liu Yifei either, and you, Liu Yifei's friend, don't even know each other.

    But he didn't reach out to hit the smiling man, and the two of them exchanged greetings enthusiastically.

    During the conversation, Huang Lei also found out that Tanichuan was a director majoring in Southern California and was the producer of the film, so he acted a little more enthusiastic than before.

    Tanichuan said: "Mr. Huang, you also know that I am from the directing department of the University of Southern California."

    Huang Lei nodded.

    He knows that we have only chatted for a while, and you have said it several times.

    He looked at Tanichuan and guessed that this person must be quite proud, otherwise he would not always show off his academic background.

    Tanichuan continued: "So I am not familiar with the domestic film industry, so I would like to ask Mr. Huang to introduce me to some people in the film industry, preferably from Nortel."

    Huang Lei had a smile on his face.

    You are somewhat presumptuous.

    This is the first time we've met, and you're asking me to help. Is this appropriate?

    "Okay, let me ask for you."

    What Huang Lei can do, of course, is to do it perfunctorily. He can't refuse people in person.

    Tanichuan didn't care about his perfunctory words and seemed quite grateful to him.

    Huang Lei's visit to the team was just a sideshow. Tanichuan's focus was still on the crew of "Hell".

    The filming of the movie went quite smoothly. It started shooting in October and by December, it was already in the final phase of shooting.

    In the evening, Gu Chuan and Cao Yu gathered in a small room.

    After getting along for more than a month, Tanichuan and Cao Yu have a good relationship, and they have almost agreed to shoot the next movie.

    Cao Yu asked: "How much did you invest in your movie?"

    "Not decided yet."

    Cao Yu paused and suddenly felt that Gu Chuan was a little unreliable. He continued to ask: "Who are you going to find as the actor?"

    “I don’t know yet, but I must find a well-known actress,” Tanigawa said.

    Cao Yu started to have a toothache.

    The actor has not been confirmed either, which makes it even more unreliable.

    "What's the script? Can you show it to me?"

    Tanichuan glanced at Cao Yu and whispered: "The script hasn't been written yet."

    "Farewell!"
